requirements: Position TP/SL entire close at trigger
Signed PnL and leveraged ROI targets converted into candidate trigger prices
native_testing: Paused at user request. No device tools, device tests or APK installation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: Position conditional market orders support closePosition=true; quantity, reduceOnly, price and timeInForce are omitted. Direction and position-side guards support one-way long/short and hedge LONG/SHORT.

Trigger-time position size is determined by Aster. Read-time size is a preview, not the submitted size. Fixed lot and notional checks are skipped only for valid entire-close shapes; trigger and capability checks remain.
Original position/configuration is independently rechecked before POST. Same selected EOA signs position GET, exact POST bytes and separate query GET. No extra wallet is created.

Query verifies entire-close flags and original conditional terms, allows origQty=0 and execution differing from read-time size, and validates statuses/positive fills/nonzero reported-size bounds. Remaining position requires a separate signed read.

PnL=d*Q*(P-E); ROI%=d*(P/E-1)*L*100. Decimal and exact rational inverse results are rounded once to the nearest exchange (price-minPrice)/tickSize lattice. Half-step ties round away from zero. Candidate estimates use the rounded price.
Selected partial quantity or reviewed entire quantity supplies Q. ROI uses entry price and leverage; it is not account yield. Conditional limit execution estimates still use the separate limit price.

Preview and refresh never overwrite trigger input. Explicit Apply only updates the field, not submission. Partial inputs survive entire-mode toggles. Unknown outcomes lock editing/Apply and recover with original-ID GET only.
evidence: Full regression suite includes existing auth, account, policy, close/batch, market and localization checks.
boundaries: Independent TP and SL are not OCO and do not auto-cancel. Attached TP/SL and linkage/editing remain incomplete.
Estimates exclude fees, funding, slippage and trigger-time state changes. Aster determines eligibility and actual execution.
Trailing/Chase, BBO and chart quick entry remain incomplete.
Aster enable-trading is not implemented; acceptance of the same EOA as its own API signer remains unverified.
Subaccounts, deposits/withdrawals/transfers, full valuation, notifications and durable unresolved-order recovery remain incomplete.
BAPI historical statistics and TWAP are skipped this phase at user request.
